  • Method Details

    • render

      void render(Graphics2D g, int x, int y, Orientation orientation, int animationIndex, int zoom)
      Render the object on the screen.
      Parameters:
      g - the graphics object to draw on.
      x - the x position to draw the object.
      y - the y position to draw the object.
      orientation - the orientation of the object.
      animationIndex - the index of the animation
      zoom - rendering zoom factor

    • getScreenBounds

      default Rectangle getScreenBounds(int screenX, int screenY, int zoom)
      Conservative screen bounds of the sprite, including atlas offsets. Returning null disables visibility culling for a custom sprite.
      Parameters:
      screenX - horizontal position in screen pixels
      screenY - vertical position in screen pixels
      zoom - rendering zoom factor
      Returns:
      the screen-space bounds, or null if unavailable

    • animationSize

      int animationSize()
      Returns the number of frames in the sprite animation.
      Returns:
      the size (in frames) of the animation

    • getScaleAnchorX

      default double getScaleAnchorX(int zoom)
      Returns the horizontal anchor used when scaling this sprite. The offset is measured from the projected grid position in screen pixels. A value of zero preserves the default anchor for custom sprites.
      Parameters:
      zoom - the renderer zoom factor
      Returns:
      the horizontal anchor offset in screen pixels
